summary: Backend: 16/16 pytest cases pass covering admin auth/stats/leads/CSV, discount codes CRUD (admin-only, uppercased, duplicate check), manager upsert, pro/interest with SHARE10 uses increment, lead creation and admin visibility, RBAC. Frontend: home shows manager-free-badge and manager-pro-card (no €299), manager detail page renders (name/rate/fee calculator updates on days change), Request-btn opens login dialog when logged out, back link works, admin login as admin@interimio.com succeeds and admin UI renders after page reload (nav-admin, stats, lead rows, status change persists after refresh, CSV export downloads interimio-leads-all.csv, discount codes tab loads, code creation via form works), /admin logged out shows admin-login-required, /admin as manager shows admin-forbidden, /profile shows Publish form with verification banner. Fixed one blocking backend TypeError (naive/aware datetime in verify-otp) so OTP verification for new users works.

minor.issue: TypeError comparing offset-naive datetime.utcnow() with offset-aware exp — fixed in-place (use datetime.now(timezone.utc) and normalize exp tz).

ui_bugs.issue: After successful login, the header does not update to show nav-admin / role-specific links until a manual page reload. Root cause: token is read once from localStorage at render into a const; me() captures the stale (null) token from the closure at the time login() is called (setItem happens then me() is awaited with stale closure token). Fix: read localStorage.getItem('access_token') inside me() (or make token state) so the freshly stored token is used.

issues: Uses native <input type=date> (browser default picker) instead of shadcn Calendar/DatePicker component.
'Add sample profiles' seeding button appears to be publicly accessible on the home page — likely should be gated behind admin or removed for end users.

action_items: Fix useAuth so login() immediately triggers /auth/me with the new token (read token inside me or use useState for token). Without this the admin/manager-specific nav links never appear until reload — noticeable UX bug.
Consider guarding /api/managers/seed and the 'Add sample profiles' UI button behind admin auth.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py verify_otp had naive/aware datetime comparison bug — patched to use datetime.now(timezone.utc); recommend also switching create_access_token payload 'exp' to use timezone-aware datetimes for consistency.
App.js useAuth relies on module-scope closure for token — see UI bug above.
POST /api/managers/seed is unauthenticated and can be called by anyone; ideally gate with require_admin like /api/discount-codes/seed.
AdminDiscountCodes create button label is 'Create' (not 'Create code') — minor doc/spec mismatch with test plan but functional.
CORS allow_origins is set from env with '*' default while allow_credentials=True — with '*' browsers reject credentialed requests; explicit origins should be configured per playbook.
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral TEST_ manager and client users via /api/auth/register + verify-otp (OTP fetched from mongo db.otps). Created and deleted a temporary discount code TESTCODE... . SHARE10/PARTNER50/VIP100 kept intact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_interimio.py. Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_interimio.py -v. Frontend admin flow requires page reload after login to see nav-admin unless the useAuth bug is fixed. Managers can login without email verification but cannot POST /api/managers until verified.
rca of the issue: verify-otp: exp parsed via fromisoformat with 'Z' -> +00:00 became offset-aware; datetime.utcnow() is naive; Python 3 disallows the comparison → 500. Fix: normalize both to aware UTC. Header not updating after login: useAuth reads token via const at render; login() calls me() whose closure captured the pre-login token; setState from setUser inside me isn't reached because token check returns early. Fix: `const token = localStorage.getItem('access_token')` inside me() body, not at hook top.
